{{Quote|But-but what about Solarine? The sunsets? We were gonna share a future!|Ziro the Hutt to Sy Snootles|<ref name="HfZ">{{TCW|Hunt for Ziro}}</ref>}}
'''Solarine''' was a location in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro the Hutt]] and [[Sy Snootles/Legends|Sy Snootles]] had planned to go there to share the rest of their lives together, but Snootles killed Ziro as an act of revenge for abandoning her.<ref name="HfZ" />
